credit: Source: GeoNames, Swedish postal code dump, 13 October 2026.
identity: one row per postcode; a row is kept when the dump lists its code
changes_by_csc: Existing rows the dump lists were kept and took its locality name, point and state; a field the dump's rows disagree on is left empty; points formatted to eight decimals; no new codes added.
state_mapping: Mixed postal admin1 (ISO letter or GeoNames number) to the CSC state iso2 by the provider table https://www.geonames.org/SE/administrative-division-sweden.html
